admission.justification: Opening, the shared pane and its controls jointly preserve a readable document while keeping marked source available, and source tests distinguish both presentations.

applicability: Repository Markdown opened in the dashboard File Viewer, including its Rendered and Source controls and marked source presentation.
conditions: The opened file is Markdown content rather than a media or other binary result.
A citation opening with source-line marks retains the source presentation.
exclusions: Rendering a diff between two Markdown versions.
Editing file contents through a viewer.

evidence: producer-proof-locators.json: BUG-R05@v1 §1; dashboard/src/panels/file-viewer/FileViewer.test.tsx :: opens a document rendered, and Back and Forward lead through opened files; dashboard/src/panels/file-viewer/DualPane.test.tsx :: renders a repository document only in document mode; source mode stays source

statement: The file viewer opens repository Markdown rendered, offers Rendered and Source controls, and keeps marked source reads in the source pane.
